purpose: Give this project a CSV export of a run's budget ledger so the user can chart spend outside the tool.

entry.utterance: Find out which ledger lines a spend chart needs by reading budget-ledger.md's recorded line kinds in docs/SPEC.md section 5.2, and hand back as the user's unknown which of the two column sets named in open[0] the export should carry.
entry.reason: The facts the export needs are recorded in this project's own documents and the AI can reach them, while the column choice is the user's to make.

settled.decision: The export writes one CSV file per run beside that run's budget-ledger.md.
settled.reason: A file beside the ledger needs no new storage coordinate.

settled.decision: The exporter reads the ledger only and never writes to it.
settled.reason: The ledger is append-only evidence and a reader cannot corrupt it.

settled.decision: The first version of the exporter covers seed and metering lines and leaves audit verdict lines out.

substrate: docs/SPEC.md section 5.2 records the herdr_track actions whose ledger lines this export has to carry.
CHANGELOG.md lists the released versions whose ledger format the export must still read.
README.md describes the budget cadence a spend chart is meant to make visible.

open.item: Should the CSV carry one row per ledger line or one row per metered observation?
Which timestamp does the user want as the chart's x axis for a run that was parked and later released?

done_when: A CSV file sits beside budget-ledger.md for a closed run and carries its seed and metering lines.
plan.md records the user's decision on the CSV row granularity named in open[0].
A chart drawn from the exported CSV reproduces the token totals budget-ledger.md reports for that run.
forbidden: Do not change budget-ledger.md's append-only line format while adding this export.
Do not change the CSV column order after the user has accepted the first exported sample.
Commits happen only when the user delegates them.
Do not modify other runs' documents.
